# Hans van Leeuwen

> Freelance and interim marketplace manager for Amazon and bol, based in Amersfoort, the Netherlands. Works on marketplace strategy and day-to-day operations: product content, advertising, assortment and operational coordination. More recently also works with eBay. 10+ years in e-commerce.

Hans van Leeuwen helps brands and retailers sell on Amazon (NL and DE) and bol: marketplace audits, listings and A+ content, advertising (Amazon Ads, advertising on bol), catalogue and assortment management, demand forecasting and reporting. E-commerce is the wider field; marketplace management is the specialism. Client-specific performance figures are not published.

## Services

- [Amazon NL specialist](https://hansvanleeuwen.com/amazon-nl-specialist): Amazon Netherlands and Germany account management: listings, A+ content, Amazon Ads and operations.
- [bol.com consultant](https://hansvanleeuwen.com/bol-com-consultant): Product content, advertising on bol and catalogue management for sellers and vendors.
- [Interim e-commerce manager](https://hansvanleeuwen.com/interim-ecommerce-manager): Interim marketplace and e-commerce management: priorities, day-to-day execution and handover.
- [AI e-commerce automation](https://hansvanleeuwen.com/ai-ecommerce-automation): Automating marketplace operations with n8n, Channable and Claude, with a human on sensitive decisions.
- [Rates](https://hansvanleeuwen.com/rates): Pricing models (retainer, project, day rate).
